name: whatsapp-privacy-shield
description: Smart, resilient visual privacy protection for WhatsApp Web with customizable blur and instant live reveal.

scripts.package: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), archiver=require('child_process'); console.log('Building package...'); const files=['manifest.json','background.js','constants.js','storage.js','dom-detector.js','privacy-engine.js','observer.js','diagnostics.js','content.js','styles.css','popup','icons','README.md','LICENSE']; require('child_process').execSync('tar -a -c -f whatsapp-privacy-shield-v1.0.0.zip ' + files.join(' ')); console.log('Created whatsapp-privacy-shield-v1.0.0.zip');"
